title: DIM / TXT Relational Dossier
purpose: Preserve dated interactions, story layers, role dynamics, uncertainty, and cross-links for DIM and TXT inside the Below / Shadow Farm system.
rules: Treat DIM and TXT as relation-history nodes, not permanent moral types.
Keep public interaction, authored fiction, later mythology, and interpretation in separate layers.
Summarize disputed allegations rather than republishing them as fact.
Dog and Farmer are contextual project roles, not diagnoses or statements of human worth.
Biblical and mythic parallels explain project symbolism; they do not identify contemporary people as supernatural beings.
Do not infer identity from hostile alias chains.
